body.title: Add dedicated security reviews
body.problem: Insrc's general review flow does not give developers a dedicated assessment of vulnerabilities or a separately chosen security reviewer model. It also lacks a defined way to check resolved dependencies against current advisories while keeping repository and credential access bounded, making it hard to distinguish verified findings from gaps in coverage.

summary.prose: Developers can request a dedicated assessment of code and dependency vulnerabilities. Each report identifies the security model, evidence, and limits of the assessment.

nonGoals.text: General code quality review and automatic remediation
nonGoals.rationale: This workflow is scoped to security assessment.

constraints.text: Cloud inference uses the installed CLI provider. Embeddings and repository stores follow the existing local-first rules.
Use an explicitly selected security model alongside existing model selections. Keep repository access read-only and constrain advisory egress to the information required for lookup.

stories.title: Configure a dedicated security model
stories.userValue: Select and audit the reviewer model independently of core, mid, and cheap.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a configured security model is available
acceptanceCriteria.then: it runs with that model and records its identity. If unavailable, it reports the blocker without a silent fallback.

stories.title: Isolate reviewer access and fetch dependency advisories
stories.userValue: Check current dependency advisories while protecting repository data and local credentials.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a read-only review scope and resolved dependencies
acceptanceCriteria.then: lookups send only approved package coordinates through controlled egress, and unavailable sources or unresolved dependencies remain explicit gaps.

stories.title: Run and report a security-only review
stories.userValue: Request a review of vulnerabilities with actionable evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a selected repository scope and revision
acceptanceCriteria.when: a user requests a security review
acceptanceCriteria.then: the report separates code findings, confirmed affected dependencies, and unverified coverage, with severity, evidence, prerequisites, and remediation.

requirements.statement: Run a separate security-only review using a specified security model and record the effective model in the report.
Assess relevant code vulnerabilities and resolve direct and transitive dependency advisory matches where exact versions are available.
Give findings evidence, severity, exploit prerequisites, and remediation guidance. Report unresolved versions, missing evidence and unavailable advisory sources explicitly.

citations.ref: User request for dedicated security reviews
